results.name: kpi-TC001 - Category view shows summary and KPIs
steps: Given an Editor navigates to a category view
When the view loads
Then the page shows a per-category AI perception summary and 5 KPI cards

results.name: GEO-70-TC001 - Category view respects market and LLM filters
steps: Given market and LLM filters are already applied
When the category view loads
Then the summary and KPI cards reflect the selected market and LLM scope

results.name: GEO-70-TC003 - 5 KPI cards are displayed with values and quality labels
steps: Given the category view loads
When KPI cards render
Then 5 cards are displayed: Share of Voice, Visibility, Avg Position, Win Rate, Sentiment
And each shows current value with unit (%, position, score)
And each has a quality label (Good/Fair/Poor) based on thresholds
And all KPIs are computed from responses scoped to the selected category only

results.name: GEO-70-TC004 - KPI formula values are displayed correctly
steps: Given the formulas (category-scoped, same as global but filtered by categoryId)
Then SOV = Visibility% x (2 / (AvgPosition + 1))
And Visibility% = mentionCount / totalLLMResponseCount x 100
And Avg Position = ceil(mean(target_rank)), unranked = penalty 11 (NOT_MENTIONED_PENALTY_POSITION)
And Win Rate = winsCount / totalCompetitiveResponses x 100
And Sentiment = sum(score x freq) / sum(freq), displayed as -100 to +100

results.name: GEO-70-TC005 - KPIs are refetched with updated filter parameters
steps: Given filter state changes (market or LLM)
When the Editor changes a filter
Then KPIs are refetched with updated filter parameters
And perception summary is refetched with updated filters
And loading skeletons are shown during fetch

results.name: GEO-70-TC006 - KPI card shows N/A with a muted style instead of 0
steps: Given no data for a KPI type in the selected category (e.g., no competitive responses)
When KPIs load
Then the card shows "N/A" with a muted style instead of 0

results.name: GEO-70-TC007 - Perception summary shows loading state then resolves
steps: Given the perception summary is not yet cached
When the category view loads
And caches the result in Redis (30-day TTL)
And the frontend shows a loading state during generation (up to 5 seconds)
Then the backend generates it on-demand via Gemini meta-LLM (internal) is applied successfully
